articles.title: Iran President to Visit Pakistan Following Historic Deal With US
articles.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is scheduled to arrive in Islamabad on Tuesday to discuss greater cooperation in security, trade and other areas, in the latest sign of closer ties between the countries following the US-Iran truce that Pakistan helped mediate.

articles.title: Israel Assets Plunge on Peace Talks After Years-Long War Rally
articles.summary: Israel’s stocks and currency have turned to the world’s worst performers this month on concern that a peace agreement with Iran will leave Israel in a weakened position with respect to both its biggest enemies and allies.

articles.title: China Stocks in Hong Kong Set for Bear Market on Spending Woes
articles.summary: Chinese equities in Hong Kong headed toward a bear market as sentiment soured on tepid consumer spending and fading confidence in e-commerce firms.

articles.title: Porsche CEO Promises Leaner Lineup as Profit Pressure Mounts
articles.summary: Porsche AG will prune its model lineup and deepen cooperation within Volkswagen AG as the 911 maker tries to revive margins battered by US tariffs and weak demand in China.

articles.title: Gold Bulls Gut Outlooks as Deutsche Bank Follows Goldman Cut
articles.summary: Deutsche Bank AG reduced gold price forecasts by as much as 22%, as investors become more wary about the outlook for US monetary policy and investment demand for the precious metal dries up.

articles.title: Billionaire French Pharma Heir Leaves Riches to Mystery Charity
articles.summary: One of the billionaire heirs behind French drugmaker Ipsen SA has left his $4 billion fortune to a Luxembourg charity and an offshore trust, clouding the outlook for the company’s long-term control and ownership.

articles.title: Bangkok’s Patchwork Rail System Faces Overhaul Under New Plan
articles.summary: Thailand is moving to simplify Bangkok’s notoriously fragmented urban rail network, where passengers must navigate separate ticketing systems, fare structures and payment methods when transferring between lines.

articles.title: SK Hynix ETF’s Assets Soar to $17 Billion, Biggest in Hong Kong
